group.statusBar.title: Status bar
group.statusBar.description: Choose what the bottom status bar shows; changes apply immediately
option.reviewer.user: You review: a card waits for your click
option.reviewer.auto-review: AI reviews; asks you when unsure
field.permissionPreset.label: Permission preset
field.permissionPreset.help: Switches the sandbox, permission mode and reviewer together; for combinations outside the presets use /policy and /reviewer
field.effort.label: Thinking effort for this session
field.effort.help: Changes the thinking effort for this session and makes it the default for new sessions. Higher values cost more time and tokens.
field.temperature.label: Sampling temperature
field.temperature.help: Higher is more varied, lower is steadier
field.closeToTray.label: Minimize to tray on close
field.closeToTray.help: When on, the close button only hides the window and the app stays in the tray; when off, closing quits the app
field.configFile.label: Config file
field.configFile.help: Endpoints and the default model both live in this file; “Switch” points it at your own copy (the original file is left alone)
field.configFile.switch.label: Switch
field.configFile.switch.tip: Pick a YAML file as the active config; the endpoint list is re-read from it at once
field.configFile.reset.label: Reset to default
field.configFile.reset.tip: Go back to the factory file {file}
field.reasoningDefaultOpen.label: Thinking blocks expanded by default
field.reasoningDefaultOpen.help: Thinking blocks start open in new sessions; Ctrl+T toggles them anytime

field.statusBar.tokens.label: Show token usage
field.statusBar.tokens.help: Input and output tokens accumulated in this session
field.statusBar.cost.label: Show session cost
field.statusBar.cost.help: Only the official DeepSeek endpoint provides an estimate
field.statusBar.mode.label: Show session mode
field.statusBar.policy.label: Show permission mode

field.checkUpdate.help: Compares against the latest version at the update source; offers “Update now” when it can install in place, otherwise opens the release page
field.updateCheck.label: Automatic checks
field.updateCheck.help: When update checks run automatically; the desktop app follows this after launch
field.updateSource.label: Update source
field.updateSource.help: GitHub Releases API; for a self-hosted source edit src/core/update-check.ts (it reads a {version, url} JSON reply)
field.kernelApiVersion.label: Kernel API version
field.kernelApiVersion.help: External plugins that declare a higher apiVersion are disabled automatically
